killedBy: hud.css: the stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) lets the level grid wrap, which is the guard against a sixth campaign level
why: Restores the trap this guard exists for, and restores it invisibly. At today's five campaign levels the row measures 260px inside exactly 260px of available width at a 320px viewport -- it fits with nothing to spare, and a row that fits does not wrap, so removing `flex-wrap` changes not one rendered pixel and no capture, measurement or screenshot moves. A SIXTH level makes the row 314px against the same 260, and `.hud-levelselect` is one of only two full-screen panes with no `overflow` property, so that overflow would be unreachable rather than merely cramped -- the exact failure issue #633 describes, and the one case where that issue is still right. Nothing pins `campaign.json` at five levels.
